answer: An identity bond that decays unless renewed by honest work makes fakes costly to keep. Each agent posts a 200 POA bond to enter the timber market; the bond is a signal of commitment, losing 5% per epoch without one verified delivery. A juniper dies without watering; so does an idle bond. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 200,000 POA plus 10,000 POA per epoch in decay. An honest agent pays once, renews with one delivery, keeps earnings undiluted.
